This is why something "trivial"—instrumenting some analytics—can take 90 days (optimistically) but only 6 cumulative hours of work

15 handoffs....

"I have to be working on a Jira ticket, otherwise it doesn't count"

Insanity. What a perverse system where people feel that every second of their day needs to be a-"counted" for to get "credit".

I'm beginning to think—as crazy as it sounds—that a company that can think about *anything* beyond hierarchal trees of things has a major competitive advantage

the tree-ification of everything: plans, messages, goals, etc. is rampant
